mapper.select:
select win.id as id, win.informant_date_time as informantDateTime, project.serial_number as serialNumber, project.project_name as projectName, enter.business_name as crmEnterpriseWarehousingName, project.estimated_cost as estimatedCost, project.crm_project_schedule_type_enum as crmProjectScheduleTypeEnum, project.id as crmProjectInformationWarehousingId, project_config_a.name as structureTypeConfigurationName, project_config_b.name as projectLevelConfigName, depart.name as departmentName, suser.name as informantUserName, CASE project.crm_project_schedule_type_enum WHEN 8 THEN '已中标' WHEN 5 THEN '进行中' WHEN 10 THEN '未中标' ELSE '' END AS crmProjectScheduleTypeEnumName, project.validity_of_registration as validityOfRegistration from crm_project_information_warehousing as project left join crm_winning_contract_warehousing as win on win.crm_project_information_warehousing_id = project.id and win.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join crm_enterprise_warehousing as enter on enter.id = project.crm_enterprise_warehousing_id and enter.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join crm_project_information_config as project_config_a on win.structure_type_configuration_id = project_config_a.id and project_config_a.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join crm_project_information_config as project_config_b on project.project_level_config_id = project_config_b.id and project_config_b.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_department as depart on depart.id = win.department_id and depart.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_user as suser on suser.id = win.informant_user_id and suser.bool_delete_enum = 0
project.bool_delete_enum = 0 and project.crm_project_schedule_type_enum in (8,5,10)
and project.crm_project_schedule_type_enum = #{crmProjectScheduleTypeEnum}
and DATE_FORMAT(win.informant_date_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and DATE_FORMAT(win.informant_date_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and project.project_name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%')
and project.serial_number like concat('%',#{serialNumber},'%')
and enter.business_name like concat('%',#{crmEnterpriseWarehousingName},'%')
and (project.department_id IN
#{deptId}
or project.informant_user_id = #{userId})
and project.department_id IN
#{deptId}
-- 只查看自己的内容 and project.informant_user_id = #{userId}
and ( project.project_name like concat('%',#{condition},'%') or project.serial_number like concat('%',#{condition},'%') or enter.business_name like concat('%',#{condition},'%') )
and
EXISTS ( select 1 from crm_apply_business_bidding_record a where a.crm_project_information_warehousing_id = project.id and a.crm_check_status_enum = 2 and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE )
EXISTS ( select 1 from crm_apply_technology_bidding_record a where a.crm_project_information_warehousing_id = project.id and a.crm_check_status_enum = 2 and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE )
EXISTS ( select 1 from crm_apply_structural_design_bidding_record a where a.crm_project_information_warehousing_id = project.id and a.crm_check_status_enum = 2 and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE )
EXISTS ( select 1 from crm_apply_deep_design_bidding_record a where a.crm_project_information_warehousing_id = project.id and a.crm_check_status_enum = 2 and a.bool_delete_enum = FALSE )
order by win.create_time desc

select win.id as id, win.informant_date_time as informantDateTime, -- win.reporting_status as reportingStatus, win.reporting_status as reportingStatus, win.construction_organization_reporting_status as constructionOrganizationReportingStatus, win.construction_calculation_reporting_status as constructionCalculationReportingStatus, win.animation_reporting_status as animationReportingStatus, win.innovation_reporting_status as innovationReportingStatus, win.construction_support_service_reporting_status as constructionSupportServiceReportingStatus, project.serial_number as serialNumber, project.project_name as projectName, enter.business_name as crmEnterpriseWarehousingName, project.estimated_cost as estimatedCost, project.id as crmProjectInformationWarehousingId, project_config_a.name as structureTypeConfigurationName, project_config_b.name as projectLevelConfigName, depart.name as departmentName, suser.name as informantUserName, '已中标' as crmProjectScheduleTypeEnumName, project.validity_of_registration as validityOfRegistration from crm_winning_contract_warehousing as win left join crm_project_information_warehousing as project on win.crm_project_information_warehousing_id = project.id and project.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join crm_enterprise_warehousing as enter on enter.id = project.crm_enterprise_warehousing_id and enter.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join crm_project_information_config as project_config_a on win.structure_type_configuration_id = project_config_a.id and project_config_a.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join crm_project_information_config as project_config_b on project.project_level_config_id = project_config_b.id and project_config_b.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_department as depart on depart.id = win.department_id and depart.bool_delete_enum = 0 left join sys_user as suser on suser.id = win.informant_user_id and suser.bool_delete_enum = 0
win.bool_delete_enum = 0 -- 未提报
and win.reporting_status = 0 and win.construction_organization_reporting_status = 0
-- 已提报
and win.reporting_status = 1 and win.construction_organization_reporting_status = 1
-- 部分提报
and ( (win.reporting_status = 1 and win.construction_organization_reporting_status = 0) or (win.reporting_status = 0 and win.construction_organization_reporting_status = 1) )
and DATE_FORMAT(win.informant_date_time, '%Y-%m-%d') >= DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and DATE_FORMAT(win.informant_date_time, '%Y-%m-%d') <= DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and project.project_name like concat('%',#{projectName},'%')
and project.serial_number like concat('%',#{projectNumber},'%')
and win.reporting_status = #{reportingStatus}
and (win.department_id IN
#{deptId}
or win.informant_user_id = #{currentUserId}
and win.department_id IN
#{deptId}
-- 只查看自己的内容 and win.informant_user_id = #{currentUserId}
order by win.create_time desc
